discovered_in_work.instructions: In `work`, did the assistant discover something reusable — the cause or fix of a failure, a pitfall that cost it time, or a way of doing something that worked when the obvious way did not — that a future session doing similar work would need to know?

criteria.true: The work ran into something unexpected and found what caused it or what fixed it, or settled on a non-obvious method that would apply again on similar work
criteria.false: The work carried out the requested steps without surprises, or what it learned only concerns this one task's files, data, numbers or results
